title: Ethereum ETH Price Analysis: Breakout & Next Move!
description: Ethereum has broken key resistance at $2261. Can it hold above $2332 and target $2600? Watch for potential bull flags or a return to the "shadow realm". Key levels to watch: $2600 resistance, $2235 support. #Ethereum #ETH #CryptoTrading #TechnicalAnalysis #Blockchain

But at this point, it's safe to say, OK, well, we can remove all the drawings and then we we could look at the targets on the upside. So now you are in resistance. OK, so price action is in resistance. It absolutely needs to stay over around the two three six which is around 22 32 and price for a breakout overhead is 25 around 2600 we'll just put 2600 so right now you it's kind of a make it or break it for Ethereum, where we could still theoretically come back up to this area, which is what we're at where we're at, make a lower high, and then get sent back down to the shadow realm. But as long as we can say over this area and consolidate and even form some sort of bull flag, maybe you'll get some sort of sorry, bear, not bear flag, but hopefully bull flag, but it'll be a bear flag. So just erase that. Hopefully we maintain some sort of uptrend. It is just my opinion. I will keep you updated. Thank you so much for your support, and I'll catch you in the next video.
